units.function: open by naming the consequence, then call the task complicated but fortunate

original_instantiations: sprawl blamed for three kinds of trouble
a theory said to hand over new ideas

units.source_excerpt: In consequence of the urban sprawl, the world is witnessing a series of problems. Fortunately, the Smart Growth Theory provides us new ideas to deal with those problems.
units.reusable_pattern: Name the consequence first, call the job complicated, then mark the relief with 'fortunately'.
prohibited_generalizations: do not open on a borrowed quotation

units.function: announce a dig with 'what on earth' before naming the metric

features.clause_structure: to find out what on earth
original_instantiations: a blunt question about the outcomes

units.source_excerpt: To find out what on earth the outcomes of a smart growth plan will be, we do a research on the relationship between the goals and the principles.
units.reusable_pattern: Pose the question in plain speech, then say the metric comes from a body of cases.
reusable_elements: a large body of case studies
prohibited_generalizations: do not pose the question in formal terms

units.function: praise and withhold in the same sentence

original_instantiations: both cities said to do well in part
a long way still left

units.source_excerpt: The results tell us that both cities develop well in some aspect of smart growth but still have a long way to achieve the goal.
units.reusable_pattern: Let the result tell you something, then cut it back with 'but still'.
reusable_elements: but still have a long way
prohibited_generalizations: do not give a verdict without the reservation

units.function: describe an effect that grows as time passes

original_instantiations: the effect said to grow with time
a forecast used to extend the data

units.source_excerpt: The results show that our plans will exert increasingly positive impacts on the smart growth of each city as time goes by.
units.reusable_pattern: Close a comparison by saying the effect grows as time goes by.
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim a constant improvement

units.function: split one problem into three labelled paragraphs

units.reusable_pattern: Give each part of the problem its own paragraph, all opening the same way.
prohibited_generalizations: do not merge the three problems into one list

units.reusable_pattern: Introduce a theory with 'there was born' rather than 'we adopt'.
prohibited_generalizations: do not claim the team invented the theory

prohibited_generalizations: do not describe a figure and then ignore it

units.function: label each assigned job as Task and keep the wording

features.clause_structure: we need to do as follows
original_instantiations: the jobs listed under task labels

units.reusable_pattern: Introduce the list with 'we need to do as follows' and tag each item.
reusable_elements: we need to do as follows
prohibited_generalizations: do not renumber the assigned tasks

original_instantiations: the paper retold as bullets

original_instantiations: a theory credited with eight dimensions

prohibited_generalizations: do not borrow a definition silently

original_instantiations: the weights stated as a triple
one component called decisive
